# Update package files to register the new slide6 for Q4_financial_report.pptx
import io, os

base = "workspace/unpacked"

# 1. [Content_Types].xml - add Override for slide6
ct_path = os.path.join(base, "[Content_Types].xml")
with io.open(ct_path, "r", encoding="ascii") as f:
    ct = f.read()
override = '  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>\n'
if "/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" not in ct:
    ct = ct.replace("</Types>", override + "</Types>")
    with io.open(ct_path, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
        f.write(ct)
    print("Updated [Content_Types].xml")
else:
    print("[Content_Types].xml already has slide6")

# 2. ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels - add relationship rId13
rels_path = os.path.join(base, "ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels")
with io.open(rels_path, "r", encoding="ascii") as f:
    rels = f.read()
rel = '  <Relationship Id="rId13" Type="http://schemas.openxmlformats.org/officeDocument/2006/relationships/slide" Target="slides/slide6.xml"/>\n'
if 'Target="slides/slide6.xml"' not in rels:
    rels = rels.replace("</Relationships>", rel + "</Relationships>")
    with io.open(rels_path, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
        f.write(rels)
    print("Updated presentation.xml.rels")
else:
    print("presentation.xml.rels already has slide6")

# 3. ppt/presentation.xml - add sldId 261 -> rId13
pres_path = os.path.join(base, "ppt/presentation.xml")
with io.open(pres_path, "r", encoding="ascii") as f:
    pres = f.read()
sldid = '    <p:sldId id="261" r:id="rId13"/>\n'
if 'r:id="rId13"' not in pres:
    anchor = '    <p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>\n'
    if anchor in pres:
        pres = pres.replace(anchor, anchor + sldid)
    else:
        # fallback: insert before </p:sldIdLst>
        pres = pres.replace("</p:sldIdLst>", sldid + "  </p:sldIdLst>")
    with io.open(pres_path, "w", encoding="ascii") as f:
        f.write(pres)
    print("Updated presentation.xml")
else:
    print("presentation.xml already has rId13")
PYEOF
